responsibility: Core SIMD machine-description file for the x86 backend, defining the unspec enums, mode iterators, substitution machinery, and instruction patterns for SSE, AVX, AVX-512, keylocker, GFNI, VNNI, and related vector operations. It is the main lowering fragment for x86 vector IR, translating GCC's generic vector forms into concrete SIMD instructions and masked/rounded variants across many ISA generations.
